stock.description: Xinming China Holdings Limited, an investment holding firm, operates primarily as an integrated developer of both residential and commercial real estate within the People's Republic of China. Its business activities are structured across three divisions: Property Development, Property Leasing, and Other services. The company builds various residential accommodations, including mid-rise and high-rise apartment buildings and townhouses, complemented by associated facilities. These include ground-floor retail units and recreational amenities such as clubhouses and swimming pools. Furthermore, Xinming China Holdings invests in and rents out commercial properties, and offers property management services to the occupants of its residential projects. As of December 31, 2021, the company managed a leased portfolio spanning approximately 136,273.82 square meters. The enterprise was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
